emailSignIn.title: E-mail sign-in
emailSignIn.help: Sign-in mails (a code after the password, sign-in links) go through one of your notification e-mail channels, with its SMTP settings. Each account then opts in itself in Users & Access. Without a channel, both are refused.
emailSignIn.noChannel: No e-mail channel yet: add one in Notifications first.
emailSignIn.notReady: Sign-in mails cannot be sent: pick an enabled e-mail channel.

emailFactor.title: E-mail sign-in
emailFactor.help: Optional. Verify an address, then ask for a code sent to it after your password, or sign in with a link sent to it. OpenID Connect sign-ins never ask for this code.
emailFactor.unavailable: An administrator must pick an e-mail channel first (Settings → Connection → E-mail sign-in).
emailFactor.codeSent: A code was sent to {{address}}. It works once, for 10 minutes.
emailFactor.otp: Ask for an e-mail code after my password
emailFactor.otpHelp: Signs you out everywhere else when you turn it on.
emailFactor.linkHelp: The login page can send a link to this address; it works once, for 15 minutes.
emailFactor.totpCode: Authenticator or recovery code (needed to turn an option on)

emailCode.help: We can send a code to {{address}}.
emailCode.sentTo: A code was sent to {{address}}. It works once, for 10 minutes.
emailCode.useEmail: Get a code by e-mail instead

magicLink.help: Enter your username: if your account allows sign-in links, we send one to its address.
magicLink.sent: If this account allows sign-in links, one is on its way. It works once, for 15 minutes.

errors.auth_email_unavailable: E-mail sign-in is not set up: an administrator picks an e-mail channel in Settings → Connection → E-mail sign-in.
errors.auth_email_send_failed: The e-mail could not be sent. Retry, or ask an administrator to check the e-mail channel.
errors.auth_email_send_limit: Too many codes for this sign-in: enter your password again.
errors.auth_email_not_pending: Ask for a new code to verify this address.
errors.auth_magic_link_invalid: This sign-in link expired or was already used: ask for a new one.
